row.evidence: Pebl (formerly Velocity Global) lists EOR at $399/month per employee with 'Get a quote', and publishes no SSO, SCIM or user-provisioning documentation; its help centre requires login.
row.notes: New row. Velocity Global rebranded as Pebl (velocityglobal.com redirects to hellopebl.com). Employer of Record service priced per employed worker ($399/month per employee, quote required), so per-seat fields are null. The public Partner API manages EOR workflows (offers, quotes, time off, employee profiles, compensation) for existing customers and partners, not portal user access. No SSO or SCIM is mentioned on the marketing site, trust centre or developer portal, and the help centre is login-only, so status is unknown. As an HR/EOR system, Pebl could also act as a data source via HRIS integrations; that is not SCIM into Pebl.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Priced per employee hired through the EOR service, not per platform seat.

scim.notes: No SCIM, SSO or user-provisioning information on hellopebl.com, the trust centre or the developer portal; the help centre requires login.

limitations.text: API access is for existing customers and partners; credentials are requested via a form.

user_api.notes: The Pebl Partner API (v1, credentials by request) covers lead/quote/offer generation, time off, employee profiles and compensation for EOR employees; it does not document management of client portal users, roles or access.

okta.notes: OIN searches for 'pebl' (no results) and 'velocity' (only Travelocity, Velocity Frequent Flyer, Citi Velocity, Code Climate Velocity).

entra.notes: No Pebl or Velocity Global entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json).

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS/ATS integrations (Workday, BambooHR, HiBob, UKG Pro, ADP and others) and the Partner API sync EOR employee data, not portal access
fallbacks.notes: Help centre (DevRev customer portal) is login-only; sign-in at cloud.hellopebl.com is email-first with no public SSO documentation.
